segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin consistently report less grease and a clearer, more controlled complexion with regular use, sometimes alongside mild tightness or a bit of dryness that a moisturizer resolves.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it works well used once a day or every other day, exfoliating effectively and preventing dry patches, though one found it very strong and better suited to oilier skin than her own.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are largely positive, reporting calmer breakouts and little to no irritation, redness, or dryness, especially when used every other day rather than daily; dissent includes one who found it too strong and not well suited to sensitive skin, and another whose skin became very dry and itchy with daily use.
segments.normal: The reviewer who describes her skin as normal reports it was effective at minimizing small breakouts without harshness.

concerns.aging: The one reviewer who mentions fine lines says hers appeared tighter and her skin looked more youthful alongside her acne clearing up.
concerns.dehydration: Reports are split and often dose-dependent: many reviewers say it doesn't strip or dry their skin at all, while a large number of others say it does dry the skin, especially with daily use, and recommend following up with a moisturizer or cutting back to every other day.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report visibly reduced redness around breakouts, sometimes within a week and a half, and describe any redness from use itself as brief and temporary.
concerns.barrier: The one reviewer who addresses the skin barrier directly says the pads clear blemishes without compromising it.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports her acne cleared without leaving any scarring behind.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority of reviewers report clearer skin, calmer active breakouts, and fewer new blemishes, often within days to a couple of weeks; dissent includes one reviewer who broke out in new places after a few days, one who felt it didn't calm breakouts or work faster than her normal routine, and one whose whiteheads improved but blackheads persisted.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers who mention oil report reduced shine and less grease throughout the day; one reviewer, however, says her skin felt slightly oily right after applying the wipes.

extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was really hoping to love this product but unfortunately it started to break me out after a few days of using it. It has a super strong lemon scent that can be a little overwhelming. It also let my skin stinging a little after each use. I didn't notice that it dried my skin out at all but I did get quite a few breakouts in places I don't normally get pimples.

extraits.titre: Good scent, but not for sensitive skin!
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Thayers is such a good well known brand so I was excited to try this product. The smell is tolerable, honestly most acne products have a strong smell but this one is definitely far better than a lot of the other products I've had. It assists well with blemishes and cleansing my face, these little wipes are very portable and easy to use and also super easy to get rid of once I am done. The only main complaint I have, that most people with sensitive skin will have is that this product does make my skin very dry and itchy when used daily but if I use this only every couple of days my skin does not dry out. Overall good product but maybe be cautious if you have super sensitive skin.

extraits.titre: Natural ingredients, good for oily skin
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] These pads smell really good. They are lightly exfoliating, which is nice. There is a ton of liquid in the jar, though, if I tilt it at all, it leaks. They are very strong. I can't use them every night or it will dry my skin out too much. I have combination skin though so it might be better for someone with oily skin. I like that it's cruelty-free and is made with natural ingredients like witch hazel and lemongrass. Overall, they are nice in the salicylic acid is effective at clearing acne.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Okey real talk - I like these pads, but they're not for everyone. Dry skin girlies, stay away 🙅🏽‍♀️ they do leave your face feeling a little tight after use, but for acne-prone skin that's totally expected. The scent is neutral and pleasant, no complaints there. I use them every other day and my oily skin has genuinely gotten less greasy while still keeping that healthy glow - which is honestly the dream combo ✨

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I loved this product it wasn't too harsh at all. The smell is very natural. I don't have sensitive skin at all so I can't speak to how it would affect sensitive skin but for my normal skin type it was great at minimizing the little breakouts I've been getting recently. I used it on my neck and my face both were very effective. They say use 1-3 x a day I used only one pad split up for 1 hr so that takes you a long way with the admonition of pads you get.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am absolutely in love with these blemish pads. They smell like lemon balm and are so refreshing on my skin! These did not cause any redness or dryness. My skin is very sensitive and my skin loved these thayers pads. They cleared up my face so fast. Not only did my face get clear, but my fine lines and my pores seemed to tighten up, which made my skin look more youthful! I love the natural ingredients in these. The pads were so moist and not dry at all! I totally recommend these if you suffer from break outs.

extraits.titre: Effective! It's a game changer for my stubborn acne.
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product is very effective on my hormonal acne. It helps clear it faster and cleaner. The packaging is small, it's portable for trips or the gym. I don't notice any pilling and very little redness. The pads have very effective amounts of BHA & salicylic acid for a chemical exfoliation and a slight rough texture to physically exfoliate as well. The redness is brief and temporary. I try not to rib hard and that helps.
